title: Validate macOS notarization flow with live release credentials
description: The xstudio_macos_zip/xstudio_macos_notarize release tooling is now in place, but this machine does not have a live Developer ID identity or Apple notarization credentials available for an end-to-end release submission. Track the first credentialed release/CI run so we can verify the final Apple-side notarization path and capture any entitlements or CI keychain setup adjustments that are still needed.

title: Clean up remaining CMake developer warnings during configure
description: macOS configure/build is functionally clean after the app-bundle fix, but CMake still emits developer warnings from top-level NSIS string quoting in CMakeLists.txt and CMP0177 install-destination warnings from bundled OpenTimelineIO/vcpkg integration. Track a separate cleanup so local configure output is quieter and easier to trust.

title: Set up release macOS signing and notarization for app bundles
description: Local macOS builds now produce a runnable xSTUDIO.app that passes standard strict codesign verification after a normal build. Remaining release work is to establish Developer ID signing and Apple notarization for distributable bundles, including any entitlements, signing identities, and CI/release automation needed for shipping artifacts.
close_reason: Implemented macOS release signing/notarization targets and documentation

title: Document macOS app bundle deploy/sign behavior
description: Add a short note to the macOS build guide covering the current post-build app bundle flow: normal builds run macdeployqt, scrub build/Homebrew rpaths from the .app bundle, prefer the bundled ffmpeg for the filesystem browser plugin, and use relaxed codesign verification for local launch. Include the remaining notarization follow-up as a pointer to xstudio-ulg.

title: Fix macOS app bundle retaining absolute Homebrew Qt framework paths
description: After `cmake --build build --target install` on macOS, `build/xSTUDIO.app/Contents/MacOS/xstudio.bin` still contains absolute /opt/homebrew Qt framework install names (QtCore/QtGui/QtWidgets/QtQml/QtNetwork/QtOpenGL/QtDBus/QtSvg/QtTest). Launching the rebuilt app then loads both bundled Qt and Homebrew Qt, causing duplicate-class warnings and Cocoa platform plugin failures until the binary is manually patched with install_name_tool. Investigate why install/fixup/macdeployqt is leaving these references behind and make the bundle runnable without manual post-build surgery.

title: Investigate strict macOS codesign/notarization for app bundle
description: The rebuilt macOS xSTUDIO.app now launches correctly without manual install_name_tool surgery after bundle rpath cleanup and post-build macdeployqt/fixup. However, bundle-level codesign still needs --ignore-resources because QML/plugin resource directories inside the app bundle look like nested bundles to codesign. Track a follow-up to make the bundle verify cleanly under standard macOS codesign/notarization flows without the relaxed ignore-resources path.

title: Fix macOS viewport drag-drop not updating transport/playhead state
description: Dragging video/image sequence media directly into the viewport on macOS plays in the viewport, but the transport bar stays stale: controls are not interactive, frame counter does not increment, and transport state does not follow the dropped media. Reported for EXR and MOV. Investigate drag-drop path, viewport/playhead attachment, and transport model synchronization.
close_reason: Fixed viewport and transport playhead sync
